name: flightdeck
description: Flightdeck observability for Claude Code sessions

server.title: Flightdeck server
server.description: Address of your Flightdeck server, for example https://flightdeck.example.com; the ingestion URL its start-up block prints (ending in /ingest) works too. Leave empty for a local server (http://localhost:4000). FLIGHTDECK_SERVER overrides it.

token.title: Flightdeck token
token.description: Access token the hooks send as a bearer token. Leave empty for the local dev token. FLIGHTDECK_TOKEN overrides it.

enforcement.title: Enforcement
enforcement.description: Let Flightdeck stop this Claude Code session and hold it to token budgets: a stop from the dashboard or a token policy denies further tool calls and prompts. Adds about 0.2 s to each tool call. Off by default; FLIGHTDECK_ENFORCEMENT overrides it.
